snippet.title: Bottle Cracks - Demo Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
Make your bottle jump using just one button! Play solo or with as many friends as you can gather in chaotic, obstacle-filled levels. But be careful, push too hard and you might make your bottle crack!

A playable demo will launch on Steam starting February 6. If it catches your interest, you can add it to your Steam wishlist: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3982830/Bottle_Cracks/

#gaming #indiegame
